correctness.rationale: PASS: In G[Q_d], d>=2, m=2^d, projection onto uniform hypercube fiber s and s^perp diagonalizes Hamiltonian into mA_G+dI and the independent Q_d walk, respectively. For same-fiber antipodal transfer, non-target amplitudes at distances zero and one must be equal; with cos t nonzero this forces cos t=-i sin t, impossible for real t. Thus cos t=0 and t=(2r+1)pi/2; phase (-i sin t)^d. Uniform-sector consistency then requires e^{-imtA_G}e_g=e_g. This is equivalent to 2^(d-2)(2r+1)theta integer for every locally supported adjacency eigenvalue theta. The theta are algebraic integers, and this condition makes them rational, hence integers. Conversely all locally supported integral theta return at *every* odd half-period. Independently reconstructed seven-vertex double-star tree characteristic x^3(x²-2)(x²-4), middle-deleted characteristic x²(x²-2)²; resolvent support precisely {-2,0,2}, while global spectrum has ±sqrt(2). The full algebra proves all finite connected G, not finite checker extrapolation.
